segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Your Honor, on behalf of the Presidential Communications Office, allow me to express our sincere gratitude for the gracious invitation to appear before this committee today and for the very warm welcome extended to us here in the August halls of the Senate of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: It is my honor, together with the heads and officials of the PCO and our attached agencies, to present and explain our proposed budget for fiscal year 2027.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Allow me first to provide some context for our proposed approach.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: For 2027, the PCO is proposing a budget of P2.621 billion, representing just 0.03% of the proposed P7.2 trillion national budget.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Our proposed budget, Your Honor, is the lowest among the departments in the executive branch, yet the mandate entrusted to us are both broad and consequential.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: With this modest resources, Your Honor, the PCO and its attached agencies remain fully committed to the formidable task of engaging and informing our citizens, working with the mass media, and helping foster a more informed and meaningful public discourse on policies, programs, and actions of government.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: We therefore come before this honorable committee mindful of our responsibility to ensure that every peso entrusted to the PCO is

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: used prudently, effectively, and in the service of the Filipino people. Next slide, please. Your Honor, the PCO family?s budget proposal of 2.621 billion is 6.6% lower than our current 2026 budget. As mentioned earlier, it accounts for 0.03%

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: of the 7.2 trillion National Expenditure Program for 2027. Next slide, please. Per Executive Order No. 16, Your Honor, the PCO has six attached agencies and three GOCCs attached to the department. The following are the major programs, activities, and projects to be funded by our proposed 2027 national budget. Next slide, please.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: The Presidential Communications Program is at the core of our mandate to serve as the primary communication arm of the Office of the President and the Executive Branch, ensuring that government messages are clear, consistent, and accessible to the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: The program primarily focuses on the formulation, coordination, and implementation of integrated public information plans and programs that effectively communicate the priorities, policies, and achievements of the President and the Executive Department.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: It involves not only the crafting of messages but also the careful alignment of communication strategies across agencies to ensure coherence and clarity in how government policies and programs are conveyed to the public.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: In a time when information is fast-moving and often contested, the program ensures that our citizens receive timely, accurate, and relevant information straight from the government.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: The main organizational outcome that we seek to achieve is public access, engagement, and understanding of presidential policies and government programs. This means that we are not only ensuring that information reaches the people, but also that it resonates with them and encourages meaningful dialogue.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Through accessible and inclusive communication, we empower citizens to engage in public discourse, to raise their concerns, and to take part in nation-building.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: To realize these outcomes, we are implementing several concrete activities.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Among these is the Freedom of Information Program, which upholds transparency by granting citizens greater access to government data and information.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: We also conduct regular press briefings to provide timely updates and clarification.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: To strengthen information literacy, we have launched the Maging Mapanuri Program, a series of fact-checking workshops designed to combat disinformation and promote responsible news consumption.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: We also undertake the coverage of presidential engagements, both local and international, ensuring that the Filipino people are kept informed of the President's activities in the country and his representation.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Ultimately, the Presidential Communications Program positions communication as a bridge between the government and the people, a bridge built on trust, transparency, and accountability.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: It ensures that the President's policies and the administration's development agenda are not only heard, but also understood, embraced, and supported by the citizenry.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Now we present, Your Honor, the programs of the attached agencies of the PCO.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: First, under the Bureau of Broadcast Services, we implement the Public Radio Broadcasting Program, which ensures nationwide access to timely and relevant information through radio.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Second, under the Bureau of Communication Services, we carry out the Government Communications Program, which produces print, audiovisual, and digital materials

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: that amplify government policies, projects, and services for public awareness and understanding.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Third, the News and Information Bureau is responsible for providing efficient, effective, productive, and economical services relating to the development and formulation of domestic and foreign information programs of the government.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Fourth is the National Printing Office, which oversees the national printing.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Fifth is the Philippine Information Agency, which implements the development communication programs of the government, bringing information closer to the people through regional and provincial networks while promoting citizen participation and grassroots engagement.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Finally, Radio TV Malacanang, or RTVM, manages the Presidential Documentation and Broadcast Management Program, which provides full coverage broadcast and archiving of the President's official activities and public engagements, both local and international.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Together, these programs from our attached agencies ensure a comprehensive, multi-platform communication system that allows the government to effectively reach and engage our people.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: We wish to emphasize, Your Honor, that the PCO has consistently been achieving its financial and physical targets.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sana po yung magawaan po ito ng paraan na huwag po ipasa

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: sa ating mga kababayan, yung pabigat po yun sa kanila,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: yung pagtataas po ng passport processing fee.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Please lang, sir, huwag niyo pong taasan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ako po'y sumusuporta po sa ating Presidential Communications Office

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: at sa lahat po ng attached agencies.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At bago yan, gusto ko lang po magpasalamat sa inyong lahat,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: sa inyong servisyo sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ang pakiusap ko lang po sa inyo, unahin ninyo po yung kapakanan

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: ng ating mga ordinaryong mamamayang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Just be, ano, ang pakiusap ko rin po sa inyo, just be fair.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Unahin natin ang interest ng bawat Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Unahin po natin ang interest ng bayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Salamat po and congratulations po sa inyong lahat.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Your Honor, on behalf of the PCO.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: And if I may echo lang po yung sinabi ng Presidente natin ng APO,

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: you have my personal assurance po,

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: na hindi po namin tataasan yung presyo at ipapass on sa ating mga mamamayan

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: yung additional cost to print the passports po.

segments.speaker: Secretary David M. Gomez
segments.text: So, you have my personal assurance, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Senator Bong, for coming, for joining us.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Thank you even just for a brief moment.

segments.text: But anyway, there being no more questions,
